scenes.line: Meet ICM Bot, the ICM coach for tournament poker.
Sign in, pick eight bots, and your tournament begins.
At every decision, the coach shows the best move, and why.
Raising takes two taps: pick a size, then press Enter.
Go against the coach, and you'll know it.
My Mistakes lists every decision the coach would play differently, with the reason.
Hand History keeps every tournament, hand by hand.
And the new Report shows your results, and your stack, hand by hand,
where you make mistakes, your biggest leaks, and how you size your bets.

endCard.line: ICM Bot. Practice only, no real money. Start training free at ICM bot dot one.
